title: Domain III: Sourcing & Supplier Selection - CPPB Domain III: Sourcing & Supplier Selection - Alternative Methods - Trial Procurements
subject: CPPB Domain III: Sourcing & Supplier Selection

questions.q: If a supplier provides free trial equipment to an agency to demonstrate its capabilities, what ethical and procedural risk does the buyer face when later drafting the formal IFB?
options: The vendor may claim an automatic sole-source award
Writing restrictive specifications biased toward the trial equipment's unique features
Being required to negotiate price before the bid opens
Triggering a mandatory Brooks Act selection process
questions.explain: When an agency tests trial equipment, buyers must ensure subsequent IFB/RFP specifications remain generic and open to maximum competition, avoiding bias toward the unique features of the trial equipment.
